patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality product photography is used extensively, particularly in the hero and featured product sections, creating an immersive visual experience.

A sophisticated typographic pairing uses an elegant, bold serif font for prominent display headings and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and UI elements, creating a balance of luxury and readability.
The palette is dominated by rich, warm earthy tones (reds, browns, oranges) derived from natural ingredients and product photography, contrasted with deep black text and crisp white backgrounds.
The hero section features a subtle parallax-like effect where the foreground text and CTA scroll up, revealing more of the static background product image as the user scrolls down the page.

The main navigation bar transitions from transparent over the hero to a fixed, solid white background with a subtle shadow and slightly reduced height once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Sections are often introduced with large, centered serif headings and visually separated by generous vertical spacing, sometimes incorporating full-width background color bands or distinct background imagery.

technique_notes: A hero section uses a large, high-quality product photograph as a background, with text and a call-to-action layered on top. As the user scrolls, the foreground content scrolls up, revealing more of the background image, creating a subtle parallax-like effect.

The global navigation bar is initially transparent and overlays the hero section. Upon scrolling past the hero, it transitions to a fixed position at the top, shrinking slightly in height and gaining a solid background color and a subtle drop shadow to maintain contrast with the page content.
Product display sections utilize a horizontal carousel component (likely using swiper.js as detected), allowing users to swipe or click through multiple product cards.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~3-4x body) for section titles, with smaller, clean sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and product cards, but mostly sharp edges for overall layout.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between sections, especially in the hero and main content areas, with tighter spacing within product grids.

standout: The site's standout feature is its rich, evocative product photography and styling, which leverages warm, earthy tones and natural elements to convey a sense of luxury and authenticity. This is combined with a distinctive brand identity featuring a tiger motif and Indian heritage, creating a unique visual narrative that elevates the product beyond typical e-commerce.
